comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
It's called "Trade Route Expansion Project", an 8 star (should be 10!) quest from the St. Petersburg Business Mediator. Arabic language is listed as a required skill, but body language should suffice to pull it. You must have completed the Sophie/St. Petersburg storyline to pull it (gangsta-uwo.shivtr.com/forum_threads/2682334 if you need a guide). Dont try to pull or leech the quest off of others without completing it because it wont work.

Once you have quest taken, you need to deliver 150 Fine Tribute Goods (Large Ships) to the Merchant GM in Alexandria.
